name: Store Locator For Goong
author: Tong Dang Hieu

sections.description:
To use this plugin, you must obtain an API key from Goong and configure it in the plugin settings. Goong provides a free $100 credit for each account, and all you need is an email to sign up. Store Locator Goong Maps API is a powerful plugin that allows you to display store locations on a map easily, quickly, and cost-effectively. It is the perfect alternative to Google Maps API, helping you avoid high costs and restrictions from Google. Simply use the shortcode [store_locator_goong] to embed the store locator anywhere on your website effortlessly.

Public URL: https://wordpress.org/plugins/store-locator-for-goong
Demo: https://storelocator.danghieu.com/
Key Features:

Store Locator – Display store locations easily on an interactive map.
Affordable Alternative – Use Goong Maps API instead of Google Maps to save costs.
Smart Search & Geocoding – Search locations by address or store name.
Customizable Map Styles – Modify map appearance to match your website design.
Multi-Store Support – Add and manage multiple store locations.
Optimized Performance – Minified scripts ensure faster loading times.

Video Guide

Watch our step-by-step guide on YouTube: Store Locator For Goong
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=0Hj62zFo9uQ

Source Code

This plugin includes the minified version of Goong JS, an open-source JavaScript library.

The original, unminified source code can be found at the official Goong JS repository:
– GitHub Repository: Goong JS Source Code
– Documentation: Goong JavaScript API

If you need to modify the JavaScript or CSS files used in this plugin, you can:
1. Download the unminified source code from the repository above.
2. Modify the necessary files.
3. Use a minifier tool such as UglifyJS (for JavaScript) or CSSNano (for CSS) to generate the minified versions.

The plugin package only includes minified files for performance optimization.

External Services

This plugin uses the Goong API to provide location search and geocoding services.

  • When a user enters an address or location name, the plugin sends this input to the Goong API.
  • The API returns relevant location details, which are then displayed in the plugin.
  • The service is provided by Goong. You can find their terms of use and privacy policy here:
    • Terms of Service: https://goong.io/terms/
    • Privacy Policy: https://goong.io/policy/
